name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA between two parties sharing confidential information.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Mutual NDA, used to fill in party details, purpose, term, and key customisation fields.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for cloud software-as-a-service subscriptions, covering access rights, support, payment, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early product access in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard SLA terms defining uptime targets, response times, service credits, and remedies for cloud services.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard agreement for professional services engagements, covering deliverables, IP ownership, payment, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant data processing agreement covering processor and subprocessor relationships, restricted transfers (EEA SCCs, UK Addendum), security incident response, and audit rights.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard agreement for on-premise or self-hosted software licensing, covering installation rights, restrictions, updates, and warranties.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard partnership agreement covering co-marketing obligations, trademark licensing, payment terms, and mutual obligations between a company and a partner.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Agreement for a time-limited trial or pilot of a product, granting limited evaluation access rights with confidentiality protections.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant business associate agreement covering PHI handling obligations, security safeguards, breach notification, and subcontractor requirements.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a software agreement covering AI services usage, model training restrictions, input and output ownership, and AI-specific disclaimers.
